notes.title: A Mining Game : UPDATE 1
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce that development for AMG is in full swing. We have lots of new stuff to show you so lets get on to it!


[h1]‍New Features[/h1]

[h3]Completely Rewritten & redesigned[/h3] - We have spent sometime completely building this update from the ground up bringing you guys a more fleshed out experience & cleaner design with lots of room for future updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35373709/4adb70c5a6e80ded4e5c34a9d4a547b93a466f9c.png[/img]


[h3]Workers[/h3] - With the new workers update you guys can build up your mining team & earn plenty of AFK income.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35373709/4bedce8aecf1df7f9aabf52991f4c880521cab96.png[/img]


[h3]Research[/h3] - Our new research system will allow you to further your game progress & increase your numbers. They take time & resources so make sure to stock up scientist. Here are some of the starting researches:
[list]
[*] Worker OPM - Increases overall performance of your workers
[*] Storage - Increases the max storage level for your upgrades
[*] Efficiency - Increases amount of ores mined with your pickaxe
[*] Worker Limit - Increases worker limit
[*] Plus more..
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35373709/2f13d9cc0e8eadf7ccb315542b0cfec85927ee3b.png[/img]


[h3]Achievements[/h3] - We are finally introducing achievements you can get in game, With launch we have 14 obtainable achievements but there will be more with each update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35373709/ea10fc6303c733a646a4753023dad2a92833ddb8.png[/img]


[h1]‍Whats next?[/h1]
As you can imagine this is only the beginning of updates to AMG we have lots of content plan such as..

[list]
[*] Combat (Combat Tower)
[*] Global Boss
[*] Items
[*] Worker happiness
[*] Offline earnings
[*] Rebirth
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35373709/f2743d87c77dfc85d7dd708055ef5fb0b9f10069.png[/img]

Thank you for checking out this big update & make sure to join our [url=https://discord.gg/MjP86YVs2r]Discord[/url]

notes.title: Content Update 0.3
notes.content:
[h2]New UI / Icons[/h2]
A much needed reskin and UI system will be available with this content update. This brings a fresh new look to the game, The UI will allow for a less cluttered screen! In addition to the new UI layout, we have added new Icons and sprites for Pickaxes, Ores & User Icons. They go for a more pixelated look done by Luic.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/RY8PDsm/compare.png[/img]

[h2]Research 1.0 [/h2]
The new research system is meant to be more "involved". Unlock research by upgrading the research center, Instead of spending money for researches you now spend a new currency called "RP" (Research Points). This can be obtained by purchasing scientist for RP (You are given 1 to start with) the more scientists you get the more RP you will gain per 30 seconds. Right now there are not many types of research but that will change as we add more weekly!

[h2]Adventure 1.0 [/h2]
The new adventure systems allow players to take their army along a storyline type of adventure, The further you get the harder it will be. Adventures will allow you to find new content and secrets. Right now it is minimal but eventually, we will add events, Weekly, and daily adventures.
